business.headline: Our model achieved a score of 0.735, improving on the baseline score of 0.423. This represents a relative gain of 73.6 percent, which reliably beats chance. The main drivers are monthly charges, internet service, and tenure. However, because these inputs move together, no single driver should be viewed in isolation. We recommend focusing business attention and data quality on these areas, while dropping ID columns like customerID at the source.
